d.ko: The diabolical demon queen Karin has risen—and you’re in charge of the dungeon she calls home! Expand your budding labyrinth, train monsters to defend it, and build amenities to shake intruders down for cash before you send them packing!
d.en: The diabolical demon queen Karin has risen—and you’re in charge of the dungeon she calls home! Expand your budding labyrinth, train monsters to defend it, and build amenities to shake intruders down for cash before you send them packing!
d.zh: 邪恶的魔王华琳即将复活。你负责掌管她称之为家的迷宫！扩建迷宫，并培育魔物保护迷宫。驱逐入侵者收集资金，让华琳大人复活吧！
